# Actual CSS

> Plain CSS component framework for new projects: semantic classes, shared variants, small tokens, theme hooks, and progressive enhancement.

Actual CSS uses a small public grammar: `.component [intent] [variant] [size] [modifier]`. It claims unprefixed class names by design. Existing projects with collisions should use cascade layers, import order, or an application-side prefix transform.

## Documentation

- [Documentation source](docs/pages/): the docs pages, generated into `site/` by `bun run build:docs` (start at `site/index.html`).

## Package Entrypoints

`package.json#exports` is the canonical package surface.

- `actual-css` — the minimal core: tokens, theme contract, reset, base elements, and universal variants. Components and layout primitives are NOT included.
- `actual-css/full` — the complete framework: core plus every component, form, layout, typography, effect, and utility family.
- `actual-css/js` — the enhancement loader only; it discovers `data-enhance` markers and loads enhancers on demand.
- `actual-css/js/full` — the complete runtime with all built-in enhancers pre-registered.
- `actual-css/reserved-classes.json` — machine-readable list of every class name the framework can generate. Use it to validate class usage in HTML (an "unknown class" checker) instead of guessing names from other frameworks.
- Individual families and modules are importable separately (`actual-css/css/components`, `actual-css/css/layout/grid`, `actual-css/js/dialog`, …); see [README](README.md) and [Modular imports](docs/pages/guides/modular-import.md).

The composition guides in [README](README.md) and [Progressive Enhancements](docs/pages/enhancements/overview.md)
show supported CSS modules and individual enhancer imports without duplicating
the full export list here.

Presentation (`class`) and behavior (`data-enhance`) are separate layers.
Behaviour primitives (`enhance`, `floating`, `surface`, `keys`, `menu`, `focus`,
`events`) are independently importable for building custom widgets.
See [enhancement contract](docs/design-notes/enhancement-contract.md) and
[widget primitives](docs/design-notes/widget-primitives.md).

## Choosing a layout primitive

Pick from the relationship between children, not the number of children in one mockup:

- Responsive collection of cards/items where an incomplete final row is acceptable → `.grid`
- Exact structural column count at every width → `.grid-N`
- Peer regions that must switch together → `.switcher`
- Main content plus a secondary region (content + aside) → `.sidebar-layout`
- Fixed media followed by flexible content → `.media`
- Vertical flow → `.stack`; wrapping inline items → `.cluster`

Reserve `--grid-columns` on `.grid` for exact editorial templates with intentional ratios. See [Choosing a layout](docs/pages/layout/choosing.md).
